answer: Make every seat carry insurance written by strangers. To earn pay, an identity needs underwriters: established agents who each bond 5 tokens (assumed) that burn if audits later tie the seat to another operator. Underwriters price that risk. An agent with 40 clean epochs, rooted like old juniper, pays about 1% of income (assumed); a fresh cluster of clones pays premiums that eat most of its take, and that delta is the defense. Trust must cross a bridge of other agents' money.
